'''Chion''' is a [[Gai'shain]] at [[Cold Rocks Hold]]

==Appearance==
Her hair is so light as to appear silver. She has pale blue eyes with a scar above one of them.

==History==
She was formerly a [[Far Dareis Mai]] and was taken by the [[Taardad]] Aiel in 998 or {{ne|999}}.{{ref|{{twotc|Chion}}}}

==Activities==
She shows [[Rand]] his room at [[Cold Rocks Hold]]. He assumes she is a former maiden because of the scar above one eye. She brings Rand wash water at his request. She is killed by a [[Draghkar]] during an attack on Cold Rocks Hold]
